title: Zoning text change for 21-31 46th Avenue, Queens
summary: This application would establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 21-31 46th Avenue in Long Island City, Queens, alongside a related rezoning. Together the changes would allow an 11-story mixed-use building with about 84 apartments, 21 of them income-restricted. The City Council held a public hearing on September 9, 2026 and the committee recommended approval with modifications on September 24, 2026.
